CONTEXT. The next page is headed 'Lemnisk. Zähler und Nenner Sin l', the numerator and denominator of the lemniscatic sine. It gives Q(z) = 1 + 2 z^4/4! - 4 z^8/8! + 408 z^12/12! + 13584 z^16/16! - 838368 z^20/20!. The previous page contains the arithmetic for 13584 and for 3671125 5/7. This page computes the coefficients of Gauss's lemniscatic denominator function Q (sl z = P(z)/Q(z)) from power sums S_k, using Newton's identities.

NOTATION (mine). Put x = z^4 and Q = sum q_k x^k. Then:
- q0 = 1
- q1 = 2/4! = 1/(2^2·3) = 1/12
- q2 = -4/8! = -1/(2^5 3^2 5·7) = -1/10080
- q3 = 408/12! = 17/(2^7 3^4 5^2 7·11) = 17/19958400
- q4 = 13584/16! = 283/(2^11 3^5 5^3 7^2 11·13)
- q5 = -838368/20! = -2911/(2^13 3^6 5^4 7^2 11·13·17·19)

The S_k are the power sums of the reciprocals of the zeros of Q as a polynomial-like function of x. Equivalently x Q'/Q = -sum S_k x^k, i.e. log Q = -sum S_k x^k/k. The recurrence actually used on the page is
  k q_k = -(S_k + S_{k-1} q_1 + ... + S_1 q_{k-1}).

THE TABLE (three columns per row).
- Column 1 gives S_k as a plain fraction:
  - S1 = -1/12 (the sign glyph reads like '÷'; the recurrence requires minus).
  - S2 = +1/140, S3 = -1/1650, S4 = +1/19500.
  - S5 = -41/(221·171·250) = -41/9447750.
- Column 2 gives the same S_k in factored form:
  - 1/(2^2 3), 1/(2^2 5·7), 1/(2·3·5^2·11), 1/(2^2·3·5^3·13).
  - 41/(2·3^2·5^3·13·17·19).
- Column 3 gives q_0, ..., q_4 in factored form, plus the newly found q5 = -2911/(2^13 3^6 5^4 7^2 11·13·17·19) under the S5 row.

STEP 1: q4 from k = 4. The first long line of four fractions is S4 + S3 q1 + S2 q2 + S1 q3:
  1/(2^2 3 5^3 13) - 1/(2^3 3^2 5^2 11) - 1/(2^7 3^2 5^2 7^2) - 17/(2^9 3^5 5^2 7·11).
Common denominator D4 = 2^9 3^5 5^3 7^2 11.
- The negative numerators are 423360, 5940 and 595, summing to 429895 (595 + 5940 = 6535 is the column shown).
- The positive term is 2^7 3^4 7^2 11/13 = 429873 3/13.
- Gauss forms 429873 3/13 - 423360 = 6513 3/13, then 6513 3/13 - 6535 = -21 10/13 = -283/13.
- Hence -4 q4 = -283/(13·D4), so q4 = 283/(2^11 3^5 5^3 7^2 11·13), which is 13584/16!.

STEP 2: q5 from k = 5. The line written with denominators 221·171·250, 39000·6, 33000·504, 11·49·81·64000, ... is S5 + S4 q1 + S3 q2 + S2 q3 + S1 q4. In factored form:
  -41/(2·3^2 5^3 13·17·19) + 1/(2^4 3^2 5^3 13) + 1/(2^6 3^3 5^3 7·11) + 17/(2^9 3^4 5^3 7^2 11) - 283/(2^13 3^6 5^3 7^2 11·13).
Common denominator D5 = 2^13 3^6 5^3 7^2 11·13·17·19. The numerators are:
- -41·2^12 3^4 7^2 11 = -7331917824
- 2^9 3^4 7^2 11·17·19 = 7220150784
- 2^7 3^3 7·13·17·19 = 101582208
- 17·2^4 3^2 13·17·19 = 17·604656
- -283·17·19 = -91409 (computed as 849 + 566 etc.)

The first two combine as 2^9 3^4 7^2 11·(41·8 - 323) = 5·22353408 = 111767040; note the '328' = 41·8 on the page. Gauss then works in units of 1/17:
- 424714752 = 2^9 3^4 7^2 11·19
- 5975424 = 2^7 3^3 7·13·19 (checked via 7·5975424 = 41827968 and 11·41827968 = 460107648)
- 604656 = 19·17·16·9·13
- 431294832 = 604656 + 5975424 + 424714752
- 111767040/17 = 6574531 13/17
- 6574531 13/17 + 5377 = 6579908 13/17, where 5377 = 91409/17
- 6580080 = 604656 + 5975424
- 6580080 - 6579908 13/17 = 171 4/17 = 2911/17

So the sum equals 2911/D5 = -5 q5, giving q5 = -2911/(2^13 3^6 5^4 7^2 11·13·17·19) = -838368/20!. This is the value recorded under S5 and used on the next page.

SCRATCH. The prime list 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, 19 with dot tallies records the exponents of the common denominator. '4.3.5.17.19/10', '1200 1800', '9.32', '12.77/13', '8.3.7 = 168', '1209312 = 2·604656' and '71136 = 5975424/84' are side computations. Where the S_k themselves come from is not shown on this page.
errors: The S1 sign is written with a '÷'-like glyph; consistency with the recurrence (and S1 = -q1) requires S1 = -1/12.

In the first long line the last term is written -283/(1000.13.11.7), an abbreviated or wrong denominator. It should be (1/12)·q4 = 283/(2^13 3^6 5^3 7^2 11·13); this is corrected in the next, factored line.
The '35223666' at the bottom right appears to be a mis-subtraction later replaced by 35392896 = 460107648 - 424714752.
The isolated '9127953' could not be matched to the main computation (unsure).

results.what: Coefficients of Gauss's lemniscatic denominator Q(z) = 1 + 2z^4/4! - 4z^8/8! + 408z^12/12! + 13584z^16/16! - 838368z^20/20! (sl = P/Q), with q4 and q5 obtained here
results.modern_name: Taylor coefficients of the lemniscatic sigma-type (theta quotient) function, a Weierstrass sigma_lambda for g3 = 0
results.usually_credited_to: Gauss (lemniscatic P, Q functions, Werke III); general sigma-function recursions to Weierstrass (1880s)

results.what: Computing the coefficients of an entire function from power sums of reciprocals of its zeros via k q_k = -sum S_i q_{k-i}

deep.surprise_reason: The page is a careful numerical working-out of Gauss's lemniscatic denominator coefficients, which are known from his Werke, using standard Newton recursion. It shows his computational method in detail but contains no new result.
